INSERT INTO `expert_review`
expert_id, user_id, rating, content,
#{expertId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content},
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.expert_id, r.user_id, p.real_name AS expert_name, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS user_name, r.rating, r.content, r.create_time, r.update_time FROM `expert_review` r INNER JOIN `expert_profile` p ON p.id = r.expert_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS reviewTotalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) AS reviewUserCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2), 0) AS averageRating, COALESCE(MIN(r.rating), 0) AS minRating, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(r.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(r.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reviewTotalTrend, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE(r.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN r.user_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE(r.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN r.user_id END) AS reviewUserTrend, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN DATE(r.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN r.rating END), 2), 0) - COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN DATE(r.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN r.rating END), 2), 0) AS averageRatingTrend, COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN DATE(r.create_time) = CURDATE() THEN r.rating END), 0) - COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN DATE(r.create_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN r.rating END), 0) AS minRatingTrend FROM `expert_review` r INNER JOIN `expert_profile` p ON p.id = r.expert_id WHERE p.audit_status = 2
